text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Another scorching summer has arrived this 
year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Last year, Seiun Sky and I went everywhere 
in search of a "special summer," but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: My, oh my, what a pleasantly mild summer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so it ended as just a decent 
summer. If possible, I'd like to find a 
summer that feels a bit more special this 
year."
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll take my time and look for it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to secretly prepare a surprise 
without telling Seiun Sky. —However.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh... "Hidden Gems of the Summer! 
Special Feature Issue", you say?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"What's up, Trainerrr? Are you trying to 
get revenge for what happened last 
summer?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, don't be down. We walked all over 
the place together last time too, so let's 
look together this time as well!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look. How about that magazine over 
there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The magazine Seiun Sky brought had a cover 
story titled, "Special Summer Memories 
Feature."
choice_data_list:
There aren't really many hidden gems 
listed, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than an introduction to the 
location, the article seemed to focus more 
on the memories made there.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Hmmm, hmm. Picked up a pretty 
seashell, saw a rainbow... Found a new 
pair of earrings... Hm.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...I see?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer, care to step out with 
me for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Let's meet up in one hour. Oh, and make 
sure to bring your swimsuit~. See ya then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Seiun Sky walked away. ...A 
swimsuit? It didn't feel like anything 
special, but is she really going to the 
beach...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hum-hum~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now, now, we'll be arriving shortly.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...From Sei-chan's point of view, this is 
totally the jackpot~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected Bubbly Land. Just why... In 
what way was this supposed to be a 
"Special Summer"?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sor-ry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep. A "special" swimsuit that I designed 
myself and had custom-made.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Maybe this was all that was needed, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~ Well, let's just go have some fun. 
Look, they have a waterslide over there~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
We can get our pictures taken along the 
way, so whoever makes a weird face loses.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with Seiun Sky pushing me from 
behind, I headed toward the waterslide.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha. Trainer, you're making such a 
funny face.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ehh. Sei-chan is always smoothly nailing 
it, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, there's another event over 
there! If you can get onto the inflatable 
boat on your first try, you win. Wanna 
compete~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after playing to our hearts' 
content with Seiun Sky—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~ That was fun. How was it, 
Trainer-san?
choice_data_list: Of course it was fun, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—This swimsuit, you know... It was 
designed so I could spend my time all nice 
and relaxed~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's a simple wish, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, it is simple. Not a heavy, 
burdensome wish, but a pure, 
straightforward feeling. However—"
choice_data_list: That's a very important wish for you.

That's a very important wish for you, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep. That's why wearing this and spending 
time as I wished makes right now so 
'special'~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It wasn't a place. It was something far 
simpler and more trivial than that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you have something "special" inside 
that breaks from the ordinary, along with 
the time and memories spent with it—
choice_data_list: I see... It really is a "special summer."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And after moving around a lot, we'd eat 
even more with yakiniku and stuff...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yay. I'm so glad it was a fun summer right 
up to the very end~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“...But you know. Was this just another 
ordinary summer to you, Trainer-san?”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
With this, I feel like I can keep working 
with full energy starting tomorrow, too~ 
Ah, but was I the only one who got special 
treatment?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Because for you, Trainer, it's just a 
normal summer spent wearing the same 
swimsuit as always, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~ Just kidding~. Am I not making any 
sense?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Because for you, Trainer, it's just a 
normal summer spent wearing the same 
swimsuit as always, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but is this something special just for 
me?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Because for you, Trainer, it's just a 
normal summer spent wearing the same 
swimsuit as always, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting on the memories made today, I 
smiled back at Seiun Sky.
choice_data_list:
Because I got to spend time with a girl 
wrapped in 'specialness'

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh my, aren't you quite the talker~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Guess this summer became even more 
special.
